fields.summary: Autonomous plan run on change set 01M602TH. No owner was present, so no owner words were captured. The change set's intent: a review check or critic session that writes no model entries still gets its actor's record entries committed, so no uncommitted record change set is left in the run worktree for a later fixer to sweep up. Today CommitCheckWrites (internal/api/run_checks.go) returns early with no commit when the session's actor wrote no log entries. The plan follows the intent as written. Open for the owner: nothing blocks the plan.
fields.title: Commit idle check actors: planning run, no owner present
